n.bookSourceComment: 基于 fqapp 逆向（x-argus/x-ladon 签名 + CM DH 通道）；book_type=2 读目录，正文经 materials/skeleton 取 web_uri 直接出 JPEG；书源URL带##后缀仅作身份区分，实际请求均为 fanqienovel.com。注：漫画频道(tab_type=9)为服务端固定推荐池，发现页仅此一个真实入口；更多内容请用搜索

ruleBookInfo.author: $.author
ruleBookInfo.init: @js:(function(){var m=String(baseUrl).match(/([0-9]{15,})/);var bid=m?m[1]:'';if(!bid){throw new Error('无效书籍ID');}var r=FQ_mgInfo2(java,source,bid);if(!r.chapters)throw new Error('未找到书籍或目录为空');r.tocUrl='https://fanqienovel.com/page/'+bid;return JSON.stringify(r);})()
ruleBookInfo.name: $.name

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var m=String(baseUrl).match(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/page\/([0-9]{15,})/);var bid=m?m[1]:'';var m2=String(baseUrl).match(/#([0-9]+)$/);var item=m2?m2[1]:'';if(!bid||!item)throw new Error('参数错误');var h=FQ_mgHtmlQuiet(java,source,bid,item);if(h)return h;var t=FQ_mgText(java,source,bid,item);if(t)return t;throw new Error(FQ_MSG_NOMG);})()

ruleSearch.author: $.author

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){var m=String(baseUrl).match(/([0-9]{15,})/);var bid=m?m[1]:'';if(!bid){throw new Error('无效书籍ID');}var l=FQ_mgToc(java,source,bid);if(!l.length)throw new Error('目录为空');var out=[];for(var i=0;i<l.length;i++){out.push(JSON.stringify({name:l[i].name,url:'https://fanqienovel.com/page/'+bid+String.fromCharCode(35)+l[i].url}));}return out;})()
